Sub.: Audio recording of conference call on the Unaudited Financial Results  
(Standalone & Consolidated) for the quarter and half-year ended 30th September, 2026 
 
Dear Sir / Madam, 
 
In continuation of our letter dated 12th October, 2026 and pursuant to Regulation 30(6) of the 
Securities and Exchange Board of India (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) 
Regulations, 2015, the audio recording of the conference call held today i.e. on 19th October, 2026, 
on the Unaudited Financial Results (Standalone & Consolidated) of the Company for the quarter and 
half year ended 30th September 2026 is available on the Company’s website at: 
https://www.piramalfinance.com/content/dam/piramalfinance/pdf/financial-results/piramal-finance-
limited/quarterly-results/2027/earnings-conference-call-audio/callq2.mp3 
 
Kindly take the same on record. 
 
Thanking you. 
 
Yours faithfully, 
For Piramal Finance Limited 
(Formerly known as Piramal Capital & Housing Finance Limited) 
 
 
Bipin Singh 
Company Secretary
